metadata.title: Clicked like a panic button and somehow got 2 kills? Valorant's math is broken again!
metadata.description:
Me: no clue what just happened
Enemies: probably uninstalling mid-confusion
Valorant said ‘Here, take these kills, don’t ask’
Click if your aim’s a glitch too!

Tap if your best kills are total accidents too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
